ayahs.text: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
tr.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.

ayahs.text: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
tr.pickthall: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.

ayahs.text: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

tr.sahih: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
tr.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.

ayahs.text: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

tr.sahih: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
tr.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.

ayahs.text: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
tr.pickthall: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!

ayahs.text: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
tr.pickthall: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?

ayahs.text: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
tr.pickthall: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
tr.pickthall: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.

ayahs.text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

tr.sahih: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
tr.pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
tr.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:

ayahs.text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
tr.pickthall: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.

ayahs.text: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

tr.sahih: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
tr.pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,

ayahs.text: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ

tr.sahih: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
tr.pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
tr.pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.

ayahs.text: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
tr.pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
tr.pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.

ayahs.text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ

tr.sahih: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
tr.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.

ayahs.text: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
tr.pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.

ayahs.text: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

tr.sahih: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
tr.pickthall: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.

ayahs.text: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ

words.gloss: and We gave it to you to drink

tr.sahih: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
tr.pickthall: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
tr.pickthall: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
tr.pickthall: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

tr.sahih: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr.pickthall: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,

ayahs.text: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

tr.sahih: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
tr.pickthall: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.

ayahs.text: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

tr.sahih: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,

ayahs.text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
tr.pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.

ayahs.text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

tr.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
tr.pickthall: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

ayahs.text: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.
tr.pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.

ayahs.text: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
tr.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

tr.sahih: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
tr.pickthall: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it, for indeed, you are expelled.
tr.pickthall: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr.pickthall: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

ayahs.text: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

tr.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
tr.pickthall: Till the Day of appointed time.

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,

ayahs.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
tr.pickthall: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.

ayahs.text: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
tr.pickthall: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:

ayahs.text: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
tr.pickthall: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

words.gloss: (is) surely the promised place for them

tr.sahih: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
tr.pickthall: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.

ayahs.text: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ

tr.sahih: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
tr.pickthall: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.

ayahs.text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.

ayahs.text: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

tr.sahih: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
tr.pickthall: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.

ayahs.text: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

tr.sahih: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
tr.pickthall: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.

ayahs.text: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
tr.pickthall: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.

ayahs.text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

tr.sahih: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
tr.pickthall: And tell them of Abraham's guests,

ayahs.text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

tr.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
tr.pickthall: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

tr.sahih: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
tr.pickthall: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.

ayahs.text: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

words.gloss: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings

tr.sahih: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
tr.pickthall: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
tr.pickthall: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.

ayahs.text: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
tr.pickthall: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
tr.pickthall: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
tr.pickthall: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,

ayahs.text: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
tr.pickthall: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,

ayahs.text: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
tr.pickthall: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.

ayahs.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
tr.pickthall: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,

ayahs.text: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
tr.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,

ayahs.text: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

words.gloss: And we have come to you

tr.sahih: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
tr.pickthall: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.

ayahs.text: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

tr.sahih: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
tr.pickthall: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.

ayahs.text: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
tr.pickthall: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
tr.pickthall: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).

ayahs.text: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

tr.sahih: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!

ayahs.text: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

tr.sahih: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
tr.pickthall: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
tr.pickthall: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?

ayahs.text: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

tr.sahih: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
tr.pickthall: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).

ayahs.text: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

tr.sahih: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
tr.pickthall: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.

ayahs.text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

tr.sahih: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
tr.pickthall: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.

ayahs.text: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

tr.sahih: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
tr.pickthall: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
tr.pickthall: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.

ayahs.text: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
tr.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.

ayahs.text: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
tr.pickthall: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.

ayahs.text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

tr.sahih: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
tr.pickthall: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.

ayahs.text: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
tr.pickthall: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.

ayahs.text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
tr.pickthall: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,

ayahs.text: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

tr.sahih: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
tr.pickthall: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.

ayahs.text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

tr.sahih: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
tr.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
tr.pickthall: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
tr.pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.

ayahs.text: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
tr.pickthall: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.

ayahs.text: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

tr.sahih: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
tr.pickthall: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,

ayahs.text: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
tr.pickthall: Such as We send down for those who make division,

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

tr.sahih: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.
tr.pickthall: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.

ayahs.text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
tr.pickthall: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,

ayahs.text: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: About what they used to do.
tr.pickthall: Of what they used to do.

ayahs.text: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

tr.sahih: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
tr.pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
tr.pickthall: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

tr.sahih: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
tr.pickthall: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,

ayahs.text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
tr.pickthall: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).

ayahs.text: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

tr.sahih: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
tr.pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
